confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Marseille and comparable French cities, not checked against live menus, booking pages, or listings. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately certain; accommodation is less certain because July is peak season and prices vary widely by district and availability. Cocktail and wine_glass were set from typical French restaurant pricing relative to beer, not from direct price data. Euro-to-dollar conversion is an approximate assumption built into the USD figures.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-to-large French Mediterranean and port cities with strong summer tourism demand, such as Nice, Lyon, and Montpellier, adjusted to Marseille's generally lower restaurant and hotel price levels.
